01

Requests and solutions

One row per request, in the order they arrived.

RequestSolution
Cost sheet creation error for one user ("No such column Active__c")Price rules now load the same way for every user, so the error no longer depends on who is signed in. Price rule notes stay private.
Comp image should update on Draft cost sheetsA Draft sheet now shows the current comp from the development item.
Delete Cost Sheet did nothing on a sheet with real order quantitiesA production sheet with shipped pieces can now be deleted. The delete dialog first says how many shipped pieces are recorded and that deleting also deletes those numbers.
"Charge customer for shipping" should not use the customer shipping accountTurning it on hides the account number box, clears any saved number, and adds "Charge the customer for shipping." to the internal PDF.
PDF columns: Location, Treatments, and Labeling on its own rowBoth PDFs read Type, Detail, Location, Treatments, with Labeling on its own row under the decoration table.
Additional notes section under SamplesNew Additional notes field on the cost sheet and a matching section on the internal PDF. The section is hidden when empty.
Art request and development item share blank info, Design ID and Padneck, both directionsAn edit on either record updates the other for Blank Style Number and Description, Blank Color, Design ID and Padneck. A value is never overwritten with a blank.
Remove Shopworx Order Number from Create SampleThe field is gone from the Create Sample screen.
New samples should start as "NEW - To Be Entered"New samples now start in that status instead of Pre-production.
Create Sample failed when art was not approvedThe approved-art requirement for samples is turned off, so Create Sample works. If a sample still cannot be created, a plain message appears instead of the generic error.
02

What changed

Create Sample flow shots are from the live org, saved versions side by side. PDF renders are from a sandbox test sheet that uses the same page code as production.

Create Sample flow Flow Builder

Before (version 4). Three steps: the screen, the values, and the record create. When the record create failed, the user saw a generic unhandled fault message.

plain message on failure

After (version 5). A failed create now follows the Fault path (outlined in red) to a "Sample not created" screen with a plain explanation. Version 5 is the active version.

Create Sample screen screen editor

removed

Before (version 4). The screen asks for Due Date, Quantity, Where to Purchase, Size to Order, and Shopworx Order Number. The last field is outlined in red.

After (version 5). The same screen ends at Size to Order. Shopworx Order Number is gone.

Not visible in Flow Builder

The sample starting status ("NEW - To Be Entered") is set inside the create step. The approved-art requirement is a validation rule on the development item, now switched off, which is why Create Sample no longer stops without approved art.

Internal PDF cost sheet

Before. The previous page layout: Type, Detail, Treatments and Labeling as columns, with no Location, no shipping note and no Additional notes. This is a sandbox render of the previous page code.

After. Columns now read Type, Detail, Location, Treatments. Labeling has its own row. The shipping note and the Additional notes section appear under Samples. This is a sandbox render of the same page code that is live in production, with test data only.

Customer PDF cost sheet

Before. The customer PDF with the previous page layout. This is a sandbox render of the previous page code.

After. Decoration table of the customer PDF now. Columns read Type, Detail, Location, Treatments, with Labeling on its own row. There are still no shipping note, no Additional notes and no internal prices. Approved for the customer PDF on Nov 17, live in production.

After-shots for each request test copy, Nov 17

Taken Nov 17 on the sandbox, on test records only, with plain test pictures in place of comps. Each one is a screenshot of the finished change.

After. Blank info sync, the other way. Changed on the art request, shown on a second development item on the same request.

After. Design ID and Padneck changed on the development item (55555 and 88888). The art request shows both.

After. Design ID and Padneck changed on the art request (66666.01 and 99999). The development item shows 66666 and 99999.

After. The Create Sample screen has no Shopworx Order Number.

After. A sample made from Create Sample starts at NEW - To Be Entered.

Before. A Draft cost sheet shows the item's first test comp (blue).

After. After the item's comp changed to a second test picture (red), the same Draft sheet shows the new comp.

After. Delete dialog on a test production sheet with 528 shipped pieces. The new warning line is shown. Cancel was pressed.

After. A second test sheet with shipped pieces was deleted. It is gone from the list.

Before. Switch off: the Customer shipping account # box shows.

After. Switch on: the box is gone.

After. Internal PDF, under Samples: the shipping note and the Additional notes section.

After. The Additional notes box in the builder, next to Purchasing notes.

After, live. A live internal PDF, cropped to the decoration table.

After, live. A live customer PDF, cropped to the decoration table.

After. A cost sheet opened by a user with the Cost Sheet User set (that user also holds the Builder and Rate Admin sets). No error message appears. A user holding only the Cost Sheet User set could not be created for this check.

After. Create Sample on a test development item with no Design ID and no approved art. It finished with no error screen, and the samples show NEW - To Be Entered.
